dashboard.title: DataFlow SalesDatamart
dashboard.description: Approved local-currency AdventureWorks SalesDatamart metrics; v1 fixed scope.

list.name: territory
list.label: Territory
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(TerritoryName, 'Unknown') AS __text, COALESCE(TerritoryName, 'Unknown') AS __value FROM reporting.v_sales_order_line ORDER BY 1

list.name: category
list.label: Product category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown') AS __text, COALESCE(ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown') AS __value FROM reporting.v_sales_order_line ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sales amount (local currency)
panels.description: SUM(LineNetAmount); local scope only, excludes tax and freight.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(LineNetAmount) AS value FROM reporting.v_sales_order_line WHERE $__timeFilter(OrderDate) AND COALESCE(TerritoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${territory:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${category:sqlstring})

panels.title: Distinct orders
panels.description: COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID); not additive across product/category subtotals.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID) AS value FROM reporting.v_sales_order_line WHERE $__timeFilter(OrderDate) AND COALESCE(TerritoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${territory:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${category:sqlstring})

panels.title: Average order value
panels.description: SUM(LineNetAmount) / COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID); NULL for zero orders.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(ROUND((SUM(LineNetAmount) * CAST(1000000 AS decimal(7,0))) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID), 0), 0) AS decimal(38,0)) / CAST(1000000 AS decimal(7,0)) END AS value FROM reporting.v_sales_order_line WHERE $__timeFilter(OrderDate) AND COALESCE(TerritoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${territory:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${category:sqlstring})

panels.title: Monthly sales trend
panels.description: Calendar-month SUM(LineNetAmount) over the shared filters; each point is anchored at the first selected order date in that month, so partial-month totals stay inside the displayed range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MIN(CAST(OrderDate AS datetime)) AS time, SUM(LineNetAmount) AS sales_amount FROM reporting.v_sales_order_line WHERE $__timeFilter(OrderDate) AND COALESCE(TerritoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${territory:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${category:sqlstring}) GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(OrderDate), MONTH(OrderDate), 1) ORDER BY time

SELECT COALESCE(ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown') AS category, SUM(LineNetAmount) AS sales_amount FROM reporting.v_sales_order_line WHERE $__timeFilter(OrderDate) AND COALESCE(TerritoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${territory:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${category:sqlstring}) GROUP BY COALESCE(ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown') ORDER BY sales_amount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(TerritoryName, 'Unknown') AS territory, SUM(LineNetAmount) AS sales_amount FROM reporting.v_sales_order_line WHERE $__timeFilter(OrderDate) AND COALESCE(TerritoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${territory:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${category:sqlstring}) GROUP BY COALESCE(TerritoryName, 'Unknown') ORDER BY sales_amount DESC

panels.title: Sales quality summary
panels.description: Reconciliation fields exposed without source row data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS line_count, COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID) AS order_count, SUM(OrderQty) AS quantity, SUM(LineNetAmount) AS line_net_amount, SUM(SourceLineTotal) AS source_line_total FROM reporting.v_sales_order_line WHERE $__timeFilter(OrderDate) AND COALESCE(TerritoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${territory:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown') IN (${category:sqlstring})
